profile.headline: Engineering at Atlassian | DX
profile.summary: Software engineer with experience developing intuitive and scalable user-facing apps.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Architect and develop scalable full-stack products using Typescript, React, and Django.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: Hired and managed a team of 5 software engineers and 1 QA engineer, leading the development of the teacher-hiring platform using React, Django, and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Senior Data Analyst
positions.description:
- Analyzed consumer debt portfolios information and presented findings to the investment committee
- Developed data pipeline solutions (ETLs), unit testing applications and other software
- Automate data imports, data visualization, and reporting
- Increased # of portfolios purchased /yr by 25% and helped raise annual revenue to over $1 billion
- Represented team on design and implementation of new data management system
- Gave technical demos to our executive steering committee and other stakeholders
